title: Church news: the News page on the phone
question: From your answers: church news replaces announcements (a post can send a notification, on by default, that opens the post), each post picks who it's for (Everyone by default), video and audio can be linked or uploaded, and leaders ask while staff share a ministry's post into church news. Now the News page itself. All three put News on the tab bar from the start (Home, News, Sermons, Calendar, More), and staff can still move it in App tabs. Two more quick rounds follow on this page: reading one post, and writing one on the phone.

options.label: A front page, pictures leading
options.thesis: The newest post leads with its picture full width; posts with a picture follow as picture stories, posts without one as short text items between them.
options.viewport: News masthead, the lead story's picture and headline, then a text-only item from a ministry and an urgent item marked Today.
options.risk: Without pictures it reads as a plain list, and a week of picture posts makes the page long to scroll.

options.label: One News: the church, and your ministries
options.thesis: A switch on the masthead shows church news or the news of every ministry you're in, so one tab holds all the news meant for you.
materials: rows with a square picture at the right
options.viewport: News masthead with The church and Your ministries (3 new), then reading rows, each with a small picture where the post has one.
options.risk: Ministry news then lives in two places (here and the ministry's own News tab), and a visitor in no ministry sees a switch with nothing behind it.

options.label: What's new, as a list
options.thesis: Compact rows like the notifications list: what's new since you last looked comes first with an orange dot, then Earlier.
options.viewport: News masthead saying 3 new since you last looked, the New section with three dotted rows, then Earlier.
options.risk: Quick to scan but plain: pictures only show once a post is opened, so it feels more like an inbox than the church's news.
